decisions.reason: Because this finned tube extends the firm’s established air-cooler business, has remained marketed beyond launch, and fits the publicly stated strategy of continuous product improvement, management is likely to continue it unless clear evidence of sustained underperformance emerges.

Because the enhanced heat exchanger tubes build directly on core engineering capabilities, appear to have survived the firm’s early post-launch pruning, and involve sunk development and reputational commitment in an innovation-oriented firm, management is likely to persist with them.
